heroHeadline: USMCA Rupture: Trump Pauses 50% Tariffs as US-Canada Frame a Deal
heroSubtitle: USTR confirmed no agreement at the Article 34.7 joint review; after Section 338 tariffs on Canada hit 50% and were paused Aug 18, Trump and Carney announced a framework deal Aug 19 still pending finalized legal text. Mexico's fourth USMCA round is set for September.
